summary: Sandbach United made a winning start to the 2026/27 season with a hard-fought 1-0 victory over Stafford Town, with Stan Tatters netting the decisive goal in the first half. The Bach secured all three points while keeping a clean sheet in a battling performance that showcased their resilience against a stubborn opponent. Player Stan Tatters has since been sponsored by Calibre Control, adding to the positive momentum from their opening day success.
